name: ArcelorMittal Long Products Luxembourg - Belval site

sources.evidence: ArcelorMittal Luxembourg's current industrial-sites page identifies Belval as a production site with an electric steelworks, continuous production of semi-finished steel products and two rolling mills, including a sheet-pile mill and a standard-sections mill.
ArcelorMittal Luxembourg's 2026 publication of its 2025 sustainability report records continuing activity at Train Moyen Belval, corroborating current operation of the Luxembourg production network.

name: QAFCO integrated ammonia and urea production plants

sources.evidence: QAFCO's current Our Plants page states that the company operates a single-site ammonia and urea production complex with 3.8 million metric tonnes annual ammonia capacity, 5.6 million metric tonnes annual urea capacity, and four granular urea plants.
QAFCO's current product pages describe ammonia production from natural gas, steam and air, and urea production and granulation from ammonia and carbon dioxide.
